name: Emperor Juntoku
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 100); Porter’s note gives the dates as: reigned 1211–1221.

poems.title: My ancient Palace I regret
poems.author: Emperor Juntoku
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 100
poems.text:
My ancient Palace I regret,
Though rot attacks the eaves,
And o’er the roof the creeping vine
Spreads out and interweaves
Unpruned its straggling leaves.
